page.overview:
Who is Moon Cow?

Adult:Height: 1.4 BlocksWidth: 0.9 Blocks Baby:Height: 0.7 BlocksWidth: 0.45 Blocks

A moon cow is a variant of a cow that only spawns on the Moon. They function similarly to the cow, except they walk backwards and wear glass on their heads.

Moon cows spawn on the surface of cheese blocks in the the Moon dimension.

Killing a calf yields no items nor experience.
